subject: legacy-tabs/primary/MAT_LEGACY_TAB
runtime: Node 24.21.0; Angular core/material 22.1.7; exact peer package images checked by qualifier
observation: The actual packed MatLegacyTab decorator provider has provide equal to the exported legacy token and useExisting equal to MatLegacyTab. Angular Injector.create returns the supplied MatLegacyTab instance through the legacy token and does not resolve the distinct current Material MAT_TAB. Replacing the provider token with MAT_TAB reverses these results.
limits: Actual component node creation, view queries, label lifecycle, rendering, other peer images and supported version ranges were not established. The supplied-instance injector exercise is a provider protocol, not a native-node test. Current Material MAT_TAB is marked @docs-private; it is used only for comparison and negative control, and this evidence does not characterize it as a stable public API or authorize a product dependency.
